# Manage users and access

## Summary

User management in n8n allows you to invite people to work in your n8n instance.

**Source**: https://docs.n8n.io/administer/manage-users-and-access.md

---

User management in n8n

User management in n8n allows you to invite people to work in your n8n instance. It includes:

* Login and password management
* Adding and removing users
* Four built-in [instance roles](/administer/manage-users-and-access/understand-instance-roles): **Owner**, **Admin**, **Member**, and **Chat user** (**Admin** and **Chat user** are available on n8n Cloud Pro, Enterprise, and self-hosted Enterprise), plus custom instance roles

{% hint style="info" %}
**Privacy**

The user management feature doesn't send personal information, such as email or username, to n8n.
{% endhint %}

## Setup guides <a href="#setup-guides" id="setup-guides"></a>

This section contains most usage information for user management, and the [Cloud setup guide](/administer/manage-users-and-access/set-up-for-cloud). If you self-host n8n, there are extra steps to configure your n8n instance. Refer to the [Self-hosted guide](/deploy/host-n8n/configure-n8n/user-management).

This section includes guides to configuring [LDAP](/administer/manage-users-and-access/verify-user-identity/connect-ldap) and [SAML](/administer/manage-users-and-access/verify-user-identity/use-saml) in n8n.

* [Set up for Cloud](/administer/manage-users-and-access/set-up-for-cloud): set up user management on n8n Cloud.

* [Understand instance roles](/administer/manage-users-and-access/understand-instance-roles): the built-in Owner, Admin, Member, and Chat user roles.

* [Follow best practices](/administer/manage-users-and-access/follow-best-practices): user management best practices.
